verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference page exists (the meter-event reference), but nothing in the pack documents an interactive reference or runnable examples, such as in-browser request execution or a 'try it' console. The Stripe CLI and MCP server are separate tools for building and testing, not an interactive API reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
